_comment: Step 6 golden set: 10 of the 20 cached restaurants, each labeled independently by reading the restaurant's own real extracted evidence quotes (in data/cached_restaurants.json) and judging what tier a careful human reviewer would assign — not by copying the system's own output. 'label' uses the same 5 SafetyLevel values the app uses, so scripts/run_golden_eval.py can compare directly.

entries.name: Rise Bakery
entries.label: confirmed_dedicated_gf_prep
entries.reasoning: Own site states the whole bakery is gluten-free with allergen labeling; a reviewer reported no symptoms. Clearly a dedicated GF facility.

entries.name: Ama
entries.label: credible_illness_report
entries.reasoning: A reviewer who specified celiac to staff (twice) and confirmed precautions still reported moderate-to-severe symptoms. A credible got-sick report, nothing outweighs this.

entries.name: BIBIBOP Asian Grill
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: Holds a real third-party Gluten Intolerance Group certification (gluten-specific, not just general allergy accommodation) but the chain itself states cross-contact can happen during prep. This is gluten-specific accommodation evidence with a real caution, not merely 'unclear/general allergy' territory.

entries.name: Chaia Georgetown
entries.label: confirmed_dedicated_gf_prep
entries.reasoning: Corrected after FAILURES.md #15: the restaurant's own site states 'Our kitchens are free of gluten... we use no products in our kitchen that contain these ingredients' — a genuine dedicated-kitchen claim, not just GF tortillas. This claim was in the evidence set from the start; the original label (accommodates_caution_cross_contamination) under-weighted it. The original label also happened to match the system's pre-fix output, but only because a since-fixed Skeptic bug wrongly flagged that exact own-site claim as promotional.

entries.name: Cane
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: Explicit third-party disclosure that it is NOT a dedicated gluten-free facility, alongside positive accommodation reports.

entries.name: Sixty Vines
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: A 'dedicated fryer' claim exists but is an undated third-party report, so it can't be verified as current — accommodation evidence with real caution, not confirmed dedicated prep.

entries.name: Supra
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: Reviewer reports virtually no cross-contact for GF-marked items, but the restaurant's own allergy notice says it uses significant flour/walnuts generally — real accommodation, real caution.

entries.name: Arepa Zone
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: Explicitly fried in a common fryer with wheat-containing products nearby, despite several GF menu items — a real, specific cross-contact caution.

entries.name: Medium Rare
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: Nearly entirely GF menu (except bread) and a diner confirmed cross-contamination directly with staff with no issues — strong accommodation signal, but not a verified dedicated whole-kitchen claim.

entries.name: Spices Asian Restaurant & Sushi Bar
entries.label: accommodates_caution_cross_contamination
entries.reasoning: GF menu and GF soy sauce reported, but a real specific gotcha is flagged (rice vinegar containing wheat) — genuine accommodation with a genuine, specific caution.
